subject: general
question: Which of the following temples is located in Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Munneswaram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Munneswaram temple is a Hindu temple complex in Sri Lanka.
 
• The temple is one of the ancient Pancha Ishwarams dedicated to Shiva in the region.
 
• it is a collection of five temples, including a Buddhist temple.
 
• The central temple dedicated to Shiva (Siva) is the most prestigious and biggest and is popular amongst Hindus.
 
• The other temples are dedicated to Ganesha, Aiyanar and Kali.
 
• Munneswaram temple is situated in Munneswaram village, the centre of the spiritual and religious life of the people dwelling in a medieval administrative division called Munneswaram Pattuva. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Preah Vihear** is an ancient Khmer temple that was constructed during the period of the Khmer Empire.

 
 
• It is situated on the top of a 525-metre cliff in the Dângrêk Mountains, in the Preah Vihear province of** Cambodia.**
 
 
 
• **Katas Raj** also known as **Qila Katas** is a temple located in the **Punjab **province of **Pakistan.**
 
 
• **​**it is a complex of several Hindu temples connected to one another by walkaways.
 
 
 
• **Pashupatinath Temple** is located in **Kathmandu, Nepal.**
 
 
• **​**It is a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiv.
 
• It was classified as World Heritage Site in 1979.
